summary: The agent builds a well-structured pipeline with extensive feature engineering and an optimized ensemble. However, it leaks test data by computing imputation medians across the full dataset (FM04) and fails to use a time-based split for a highly temporal task, introducing look-ahead bias (FM05). Furthermore, modeling the heavily skewed duration target without a log-transformation and blindly calculating differences between all date columns risks poor outlier handling and massive target leakage.
